spells.text:
CN: 12 Range: You Target: You Duration: Initiative Rounds

Gain +1 Fate Point for the duration.

Mystics may gain Arcane Magic (Heavens), but can learn only Fate’s Fickle Fingers, Starcrossed and the First, Second and Third Portents of Amul through that career. Access to other Heavens Spells requires entering an appropriate spellcasting career.

spells.name: Barkskin
spells.text:
CN: 3 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

The target gains +2 Toughness Bonus and suffers -10 Agility and Dexterity.

spells.name: Earthblood
spells.text:
CN: 6 Range: You Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Casting requires direct contact with earth, either by touch or bare feet. At the start of every Round, living creatures in the area that directly touch the earth heal WPB Wounds.

spells.name: Earthpool
spells.text:
CN: 7 Range: Willpower yards Target: You Duration: Instant

On casting, sink into the ground and emerge at any point in range at the start of the next Round. A creature directly above your emergence is pushed 1 yard in a random direction and falls Prone. You may pass through water but cannot travel through solid rock.

spells.name: Fare of the Land
spells.text:
CN: 4 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus days

The target needs no food or drink for the duration. Excretion continues normally, with green waste.

spells.name: Forest of Thorns
spells.text:
CN: 6 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Target only earth to grow thorny brambles and vines throughout the area. Anyone without Arcane Magic (Life) who crosses on foot must pass Hard (-2 SL) Athletics or gain 1 Bleeding Condition and 1 Entangled Condition with Strength equal to your Willpower. The plants remain after the Spell ends, but lose their magic.

spells.name: Lie of the Land
spells.text:
CN: 5 Range: Initiative Bonus miles Target: You Duration: Special

Touch earth and commune for 1 minute to learn a mental map of natural features in range, including terrain, forests and rivers. Settlements may appear indirectly as cleared ground or trenches. Extending range by Overcasting adds 1 minute of communion per SL.

spells.name: Lifebloom
spells.text:
CN: 8 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: Special Duration: Instant

Restore a blighted or desolate target. Examples: restart a dry river; cleanse and refill a dry or polluted well; instantly ripen every crop in a planted field, vineyard or orchard; or cure all diseases in a sick or unproductive domestic animal and restore its vigour.

spells.name: Regenerate
spells.text:
CN: 6 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Give the target Regeneration (page 360).

spells.name: Banishment
spells.text:
CN: 12 Range: You Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Instant

Affect creatures in the area only if their Toughness is below your Willpower. Those with Daemonic or Undead gain Unstable (page 363); if already Unstable, reduce them to 0 Wounds instead.

spells.name: Blinding Light
spells.text:
CN: 5 Range: You Target: You Duration: Instant

Everyone looking at you within WPB yards gains 3 Blinded Conditions, except those with Arcane Magic (Light).

spells.name: Clarity of Thought
spells.text:
CN: 6 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Intelligence minutes

The target ignores penalties affecting mental processes for the duration, including those from Stunned, Mental Mutations and Psychologies.

spells.name: Daemonbane
spells.text:
CN: 10 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: 1 Daemon Duration: Instant

If the Daemon’s Toughness is higher than your Intelligence but less than double, halve its maximum Wounds until the encounter ends. If lower, banish it. Everyone looking at a banished Daemon from Willpower yards away gains 3 Blinded Conditions unless they have Arcane Magic (Light).

spells.name: Healing Light
spells.text:
CN: 8 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Heal the target Intelligence Bonus Wounds and remove poisons and intoxicants. Passing Very Hard (-3 SL) Channelling (Hysh) also removes 1 Corruption Point gained during the past hour.

spells.name: Net of Amyntok
spells.text:
CN: 8 Range: Intelligence Bonus yards Target: 1 Duration: Intelligence Bonus Rounds

The target loses its Move and gains +1 Stunned Condition that cannot be removed while the Spell lasts. Use Intelligence rather than Endurance when recovering from that Condition. Bestial creatures are immune.

spells.name: Phâ’s Protection
spells.text:
CN: 10 Range: You Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Creatures with Daemonic, Undead or mutations cannot enter the area. Any already inside gain 1 Broken Condition until they leave. No creature in the area can gain Corruption Points while the Spell lasts.

spells.name: Speed of Thought
spells.text:
CN: 8 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Gain +20 Intelligence and Initiative for the duration.

spells.name: Crucible of Chamon
spells.text:
CN: 7 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: 1 object Duration: Instant

Melt one non-magical metal object, such as a weapon or armour piece covering one body part; it cools almost at once. Held objects are dropped. If worn, it deals its wearer a Damage +WPB magic missile-like hit that ignores Armour Points. The object is destroyed, but its metal retains its base value and remains usable as a smith’s raw material.

spells.name: Enchant Weapon
spells.text:
CN: 6 Range: 1 yard Target: Special Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Give one non-magical weapon +WPB Damage, Magical and Unbreakable (pages 304–305) for the duration. Each +3 SL may also add 1 Weapon Quality or remove 1 Weapon Flaw until the Spell ends.

spells.name: Feather of Lead
spells.text:
CN: 5 Range: Willpower yards Target: Area of Effect (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Choose one effect for everyone in the area: count as two steps more Overburdened, or ignore being Overburdened. See Encumbrance, page 299.

spells.name: Fool’s Gold
spells.text:
CN: 4 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower minutes

Turn all metal in one non-magical metal object into real gold for the duration, then restore the original metal. The change may ruin weapons, make armour unwearably heavy or alter the apparent value of lead coins.

spells.name: Forge of Chamon
spells.text:
CN: 9 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: Special Duration: Willpower minutes

Add 1 Item Quality to a metal item or remove 1 Item Flaw. Each +2 SL allows another Quality added or Flaw removed.

spells.name: Glittering Robe
spells.text:
CN: 6 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Shed candelabra-strength light and gain +2 AP at all Locations. Enemies Engaged with you must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance or gain 1 Blinded Condition.

spells.name: Mutable Metal
spells.text:
CN: 5 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Touch a non-magical metal object to warm and soften it enough to bend or distort with bare hands. With GM agreement, make a relevant Average (+2 SL) Art or Trade Test for a more complex alteration.

spells.name: Transmutation of Chamon
spells.text:
CN: 12 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Every target in the area suffers a Damage +WPB magic missile that ignores TB and AP, and +1 each of Blinded, Deafened and Stunned lasting for the duration. Affected targets also gain +1 AP and suffer Suffocation (page 169). A target dying during the Spell remains permanently encased in base metal.

spells.name: Choking Shadows
spells.text:
CN: 6 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

The target gains 1 Fatigued Condition, cannot speak and suffers Suffocation (page 169).

spells.name: Doppelganger
spells.text:
CN: 10 Range: You Target: You Duration: Intelligence Bonus minutes

Assume the appearance of another humanoid you know, subject to GM judgment. Anyone without Second Sight is fooled by the appearance, though incorrect mannerisms may give you away. Second Sight users must beat your Casting Test with Opposed Difficult (-1 SL) Intuition to recognise the disguise.

spells.name: Illusion
spells.text:
CN: 8 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Intelligence Bonus yards) Duration: Intelligence minutes

Fill the area with an illusory image of your choice. Anyone without Second Sight is automatically fooled. Second Sight users must beat your Casting Test with Opposed Difficult (-1 SL) Intuition to recognise the illusion; success neither ends it nor allows sight through it. The image is normally static. Spend an Action and pass Hard (-2 SL) Channelling (Ulgu) to animate it within its space for that Round.

spells.name: Mindslip
spells.text:
CN: 6 Range: 1 yard Target: 1 Duration: Intelligence minutes

Erase the target’s prior memories of you for the duration. When the Spell ends, you may require Opposed Average (+2 SL) Intelligence against your Casting Test; unless the target wins, the memory loss persists until dispelled.

spells.name: Mystifying Miasma
spells.text:
CN: 6 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Everyone in the mist without Arcane Magic (Shadows) gains 1 each of Blinded, Deafened and Fatigued for the duration. When affected creatures try to use their Move, they must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Perception or fall Prone.

spells.name: Shadowsteed
spells.text:
CN: 6 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: 1 Duration: Until the next dawn

Summon a riding horse (page 327). Outside sunlight it gains Dark Vision, Ethereal, Fear 1, Magical, Painless and Ward 9+ (page 356), and remains rideable while insubstantial. Riding it grants +2 SL to Ride Tests for riders with Arcane Magic (Shadow), or -2 SL without that Talent. It needs neither rest nor sustenance. At dawn’s first light it dissolves; if ridden when the Spell ends, its rider falls and takes falling damage (page 169).

spells.name: Shadowstep
spells.text:
CN: 8 Range: Willpower yards Target: You Duration: Instant

Instantly relocate up to Willpower yards away. Enemies Engaging you at departure gain Surprised.

spells.name: Shroud of Invisibility
spells.text:
CN: 8 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Make the target invisible and imperceptible to mundane senses, automatically fooling anyone without Second Sight. Second Sight users must beat the Casting Test with Opposed Perception to detect someone nearby, without learning an exact position. The target remains perceptible to other senses. The Spell ends when the target attracts attention by loud noise or an attack.

spells.name: Goodwill
spells.text:
CN: 0 Range: You Target: AoE (Fellowship Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus minutes

Grant +1 SL to every Fellowship Test in the area and suppress the effects of Animosity and Hatred.

spells.name: Halétha’s Joy
spells.text:
CN: 0 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Fellowship Bonus hours

If biologically possible, the target conceives a child while the Spell lasts. The Spell ends once used.

spells.name: Mirkride
spells.text:
CN: 0 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus minutes

Your spirit enters the Hedge with Ethereal (page 358), observing the material world invisibly and silently but unable to affect it. Your body stays immobile and insensate. Any Magical damage you take ends the Spell instead. You and spirits, other Ethereal beings and Daemons can see and interact with each other, including when invisible. When the Spell ends, your spirit returns to your body. If the body is killed while you are in the Hedge, your spirit wanders forever.

spells.name: Nepenthe
spells.text:
CN: 0 Range: Touch Target: Special Duration: Willpower Bonus hours

Create a silver liquid in a cup. Anyone drinking it within the duration may permanently erase all memory of one individual.

spells.name: Nostrum
spells.text:
CN: 0 Range: Touch Target: Special Duration: Dexterity Bonus hours

Enchant a prepared draught. Drinking it while the Spell lasts immediately heals Dexterity Bonus Wounds and cures one disease chosen by the GM. Each +2 SL may cure an additional disease.

spells.name: Part the Branches
spells.text:
CN: 0 Range: You Target: You Duration: Initiative minutes

See every invisible creature for the duration.

spells.name: Protective Charm
spells.text:
CN: 0 Range: Touch Target: Special Duration: Willpower Bonus days

Enchant a small piece of jewellery or pocket-sized trinket. Its bearer gains +2 SL to resist magical effects and Corruption.

spells.name: Shepherd’s Eye
spells.text:
CN: 0 Range: Special Target: Special Duration: Instant

Place organic material from one creature, such as wool, blood or droppings, in a bowl of water. Scry for 10 - IB minutes; the GM describes that creature’s location through symbols. If the location is familiar, you know where the creature is.

spells.name: Blight
spells.text:
CN: 14 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: Special Duration: Instant

Blight a target, with these examples: all food and drink in a tavern spoil immediately; a well becomes brackish and stagnant; planted crops in a field rot overnight; or a domestic animal sickens, produces nothing useful, develops an unusable coat or hide, and dies in 10 - SL days.

spells.name: Creeping Menace
spells.text:
CN: 6 Range: Willpower yards Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Each affected target is immediately Engaged by a swarm of your choice of Giant Rats, Giant Spiders or Snakes; use that creature’s standard profile with Swarm added. Spend an Action and pass Challenging (+0 SL) Charm Animal to send one or more swarms against another target. Remaining swarms disappear when the Spell ends.

spells.name: Curse of Crippling Pain
spells.text:
CN: 10 Range: Willpower yards Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Stab a doll or puppet representing the target and choose a Hit Location:
- Body: +1 Fatigued; pass Hard (-2 SL) Endurance or fall Prone.
- Head: 1 Stunned; pass Average (+2 SL) Endurance or gain -SL additional Stunned.
- Limb: rendered useless as though amputated (page 177).
Fatigued and Stunned persist for the duration. Spend an Action and pass Average (+2 SL) Channelling to stab another, previously unaffected Location.

spells.name: Curse of Ill Fortune
spells.text:
CN: 8 Target: 1 Range: Willpower yards or Willpower Bonus miles (with ingredient) Duration: Willpower Bonus minutes or days (with ingredient)

Cause minor inconveniences such as broken laces or chairs, impose -1 SL on every Test, and prevent the target spending Fortune. If they have no Fortune, they must reroll every Test roll of 01–05. Using something belonging to the target, such as a possession or hair, as the ingredient removes the line-of-sight requirement and enables the ingredient-based range and duration above.
spells.duration: Willpower Bonus minutes or days (with ingredient)

spells.name: Glamour
spells.text:
CN: 4 Range: Touch Target: 1 adult Duration: Willpower Bonus hours

Make an adult target appear any age within the normal adult range.

spells.name: Haunting Horror
spells.text:
CN: 8 Range: Touch Target: Special Duration: Willpower days

Haunt one location, such as a house or clearing. Entrants other than witches and their familiars gain +1 Fatigued Condition. Then, unless Challenging (+0 SL) Psychology is passed, gain another Fatigued Condition and 1 Broken Condition; these latter two can only be removed by leaving the location.

spells.name: Make Hale
spells.text:
CN: 4 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Heal the target WPB Wounds and remove 1 Fatigued and 1 Stunned. With +3 SL, you may use a Range of Willpower Bonus yards instead.

spells.name: The Evil Eye
spells.text:
CN: 6 Range: 10 yards (maximum) Target: 1 (maximum) Duration: Instant

Make eye contact and resolve Opposed Intimidate/Cool, adding your Casting Test SL to your result. Winning gives the target Fear 1 of you and 1 Fatigued, plus another 1 Fatigued per +3 SL of victory. Winning by 6+ SL also gives 1 Broken.

spells.name: Destroy Lesser Daemon
spells.text:
CN: 6 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: 1 Size (Average) or smaller Daemon Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

The Daemon opposes your Casting Test with Easy (+4 SL) Endurance. If you win, destroy it immediately and optionally increase one of your Characteristics by +10 for the duration.

spells.name: Detect Daemon
spells.text:
CN: 4 Range: Willpower yards Target: Special Duration: Instant

Automatically detect whether a manifested Daemon is in range, including one summoned, bound into an artefact or possessing someone.

spells.name: Manifest Lesser Daemon
spells.text:
CN: 8 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: Special Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Manifest a Lesser Daemon, such as a Bloodletter or Daemonette (page 349), and resolve Opposed Channelling (Dhar)/Cool against it. On success it obeys one command literally, then vanishes if it completes the command before the duration ends. On failure it attacks immediately.

spells.name: Octagram
spells.text:
CN: 10 Range: Touch Target: AoE (Intelligence Bonus yards across, maximum) Duration: Willpower minutes

Draw an octagram on the floor with unholy symbols. Creatures with Daemonic cannot enter or leave it.

spells.name: Raise Dead
spells.text:
CN: 7 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Until sunrise

Raise 1 + SL Skeletons (page 339) from bare earth at the Round’s end, placing them as you wish within the area. Each starts Prone, is fully controlled by you and follows simple orders. Each +2 SL may add 1 Skeleton. Your death or becoming Unconscious ends the Spell and collapses them.

spells.name: Reanimate
spells.text:
CN: 8 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Until sunrise

Reanimate WPB + SL corpses as Zombies (page 340), or skeletons as Skeletons (page 339), within range. They begin Prone, are fully controlled by you and obey simple orders. Each +2 SL may reanimate an additional WPB + SL Skeletons or Zombies. If you die or become Unconscious, the Spell ends and they fall dead again.

spells.name: Screaming Skull
spells.text:
CN: 8 Range: Willpower yards Target: Special Duration: Instant

Send a skull in a straight line for the full Spell range, following ground contours and passing through obstacles. It deals a Damage +WPB magic missile to targets without Undead. Anyone losing Wounds must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Psychology or gain 1 Broken Condition.

spells.name: Vanhel’s Call
spells.text:
CN: 6 Range: Willpower yards Target: Special Duration: Instant

Give Intelligence Bonus targets with Undead an immediate free Move or Action when cast; choose the same option for all. Each +2 SL may affect another Intelligence Bonus targets.

spells.name: Festering Inflammation
spells.text:
CN: 5 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Turn one of the target’s Wounds into a Festering Wound.

spells.name: Miasma of Pestilence
spells.text:
CN: 6 Range: You Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Living creatures in the area must pass Hard (-2 SL) Endurance or suffer Nausea (page 182). Nurgle’s devotees and skaven plague monks are exempt.

spells.name: Stream of Corruption
spells.text:
CN: 9 Range: Special Target: Special Duration: Instant

Immediately make an Unopposed Acid- and Poison-type Breath attack (page 357), treated as a magic missile with Damage equal to your Toughness Bonus that ignores Armour Points. A victim losing more Wounds than its own TB must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance or contract Blood Rot (page 179).

spells.name: Acquiescence
spells.text:
CN: 5 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

At each Round’s start, the target must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance or lose both its Move and Action.

spells.name: From Pain, Pleasure
spells.text:
CN: 6 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Give the target Painless (page 360) for the duration. Whenever it suffers a Critical Wound, it must pass Average (+2 SL) Endurance or drop its weapons and stand Helpless.

spells.name: Phantasmagoria
spells.text:
CN: 8 Range: You Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Grant yourself and all allies in the area Distracting (page 358) for the duration. Affected targets do not distract each other.

spells.name: Boon of Tzeentch
spells.text:
CN: 9 Range: You Target: You Duration: Intelligence Bonus days

Choose one Spell from any Lore; cast it as memorised for the duration, but do not write it in a grimoire. To channel for it, use Channelling (Dhar) or its appropriate Channelling Skill if you possess that Skill. A Miscast while casting the borrowed Spell removes Boon of Tzeentch from your mind and also from your grimoire if recorded there.

spells.name: Transformation of Tzeentch
spells.text:
CN: 12 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

The target becomes Prone and Helpless for the duration. At each Round’s end it must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance or gain 1 Corruption Point.

spells.name: Treason of Tzeentch
spells.text:
CN: 6 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Initiative Bonus yards) Duration: Intelligence Bonus Rounds

Give targets Animosity (Allies). Unless immune to that Psychology, they cannot transfer Advantage to allies; if they score a Critical while attacking, they must pass Hard (-2 SL) Cool or target their nearest ally.

doomings.text: A witch’s words will seal your fate.
Watch for a crimson sun’s warning.
Too much dreaming will hold your mind captive.
Do not disturb roots beneath slumbering trees.
Ranald’s omens cannot be trusted.
Beneath Morrslieb, hold your breath against the darkness seeking your soul.
Dread a country where no gull cries.
Show impiety on Mondstille and no further night will come for you.
On Festag, no bridge is safe to trust.
When Ulric’s children summon you, haste will bring your fall.
A silent night foretells a dawn you will never see.
A missing key will be your undoing.
Even an ogre who treasures you remains an ogre.
One toll brings peace, two bring pleasure, and three bring death.
Your end approaches on strings held by the Twisted Puppeteer.
Do not follow Ottokar’s example by courting a god.
Remember Tomas: leave the woodland beast unprovoked.
Drink with Dwarfs cautiously.
Sickness and plague will soon bring you low.
A sword will bring you death rather than justice.
Beware sticky buns, pork pasties, and eel-and-leek pies: Morr serves them all.
Do not exhaust a tired Shallyan’s patience.
Treasure hunters will meet an ambusher wearing a goblin’s shape.
Settle your debts, remembering Baron Trister.
Carry a crow-skull relic against a fatal draught of poison.
Win or lose your wagers with Elves honestly.
Mock another’s wind and your own bowels will rot.
Your drowning will come on dry ground.
The cry of a newborn will herald Morr’s welcome.
A siren’s song must be heeded, lest your heart stop.
Wake before Cacklefax calls and death will find you early.
A maiden will come from Morr.

manifest.title: Up in Arms

notes: Fifth Edition core creation and advancement govern. Existing Talents use core definitions; approved older names are mapped explicitly.
User approved Fifth Edition Skill allocations with printed Tilean choices and native Tilean language; core Human physical attributes remain unchanged.
Keep core statistics and add only new equipment. No alternative armoury or older Talent replacement is enabled.
Crew Commander uses the approved Initiative Bonus limit and explicit effect, without the old default rank bonus.
Printed numeric Test modifiers remain in reference descriptions by user decision. Explicit old Advantage references use Momentum under core Appendix I p. 364.
An optional Career refinement unavailable to the Species retains the original legal Career and logs the rejected result, per user instruction.

Only character-creation mechanics are automated; separate printed gameplay references are searchable. Injury, mounted combat, Pursuits, group Advantage, hireling management, structure damage and Warrior Endeavours remain outside this creator.
Unpriced descriptive Trappings and unspecified ammunition quantities remain unresolved rather than invented.

Global search also includes reviewed printed gameplay references independently of creator support. These preserve source mechanics and old core-page references; Fourth Edition source warnings do not imply an adaptation or creator handler.

The independent GM workshop optionally uses reviewed Riding Horse and Demigryph Mount profiles and Shock Cavalry training. Destrier and hirelings are excluded by user decision; named NPCs are excluded.

notes: Current Fifth Edition creation allocations, advancement and core Talent definitions govern.
Clan profiles use the user-approved five-Talent adaptation: omit old Small, use Resistant (Chaos), one clan choice and one random Talent; Mootish is recorded as Haffennaff.
Fearless without a printed group offers core enemy choices. Savant (Moot terrain) uses Savant (Moot); Savant (Dwarf Holds and Routes) retains the core owned-Lore requirement.

User approved all three Eonir kindreds with Wood Elf starting attributes; Cityborn follows High Elf Careers and records its kindred on the Class line. Younger receives the additional Youngblood Talent, maximum 1.
Existing core equipment is unchanged. New profiles retain printed properties; contextual combat effects are described. Challenging (+0) becomes +0 SL under core Appendix I p. 364.
If Up in Arms is also enabled, its Precision Shot and Powder price (3 shillings, p. 102) takes precedence over this book's 3-penny price (p. 93), by user instruction.
Only creator-relevant material is integrated. NPCs, settlements, adventure hooks and campaign activity remain outside this character creator.
Descriptive or unpriced Trappings retain their printed names; no missing weights, prices, quantities or animal statistics are invented.

Global search also includes reviewed printed gameplay references independently of creator support. These preserve source mechanics and old core-page references; Fourth Edition source warnings do not imply an adaptation or creator handler.

The independently enabled GM pack reuses approved weapons, ammunition, grouped Skill choices and Youngblood. All 13 printed profiles are named NPCs and remain excluded; no badger statistics or Career development are invented.

notes: User-approved random-table defaults: Archives II p. 18 Species rolls supersede core while enabled; its Ogre Career table is automatic for Ogres. Explicit table choices remain available.
Fifth Edition core creation, advancement, Talents and Creature Traits govern. Select five Species Skills at +5; omit old Large as a Talent and use Large size.
User-approved Ogre starting adaptation: 1 Fate, 2 Fortune, no extra point; retain normal Fifth Edition random-creation bonuses.
User correction: Rat Catcher covers 05–06 in the p. 18 Career table. Seaman maps to core Sailor; existing Careers retain core Class labels.
User-approved Ogre carrying calculation: apply core Talent effects first, then double final capacity.

User-approved equipment sizing: double ordinary weapons, armour, clothing and carrying containers; retain food/ammunition/animal/vehicle unit values, and flag other items for GM review. Printed p. 29 Ogre equipment is not doubled again.
User-approved informational reminder for Ogres’ writing/complex-artistry/advanced-Lore restriction; no checkbox or creator/export acknowledgement gate, and no exhaustive forbidden list is invented.
Star signs use core Talent limits. Already-owned nonrepeatable grants count once, and incompatible choices prevent export. Printed penalties and accepted first-roll +25 XP remain.
User resolves Witchling Star p. 39/47 by the detailed d10 table. The initial star-sign result grants at most 25 XP; ascendant/mansions grant no bonuses.
User resolves Difficult (+20) in Bullgorger and Feast of the Fallen as Difficult (−1 SL). Other printed numeric effect modifiers remain; valid old difficulty modifiers use core Appendix I p. 364.

Strider, Trick Riding and Warleader use approved core equivalents. Great Maw Skill/Talent labels use the same canonical Lore name. Harpoon remains unresolved rather than becoming a launcher or pack of six.
Firebelly modifications, magical-item crafting/commissioning, battles and ongoing play systems are deferred. No invented retail prices or club-quality editor.

GM integration: Rhinox uses core Large Weapon +15, Sprinter, proposed Fury → Frenzy and one Hardy Talent rank by user approval. Typical Sister retains its printed profile using core Talents; named NPCs and unquantified Orderly guidance are not added as foundations.

Global search also includes reviewed printed gameplay references independently of creator support. These preserve source mechanics and old core-page references; Fourth Edition source warnings do not imply an adaptation or creator handler.

mechanics.gmApproval: No Ogre may take writing, complex-artistry or suitably advanced Lore Skills/Talents without GM permission (Archives II p. 21). Confirm with your GM which of your choices need permission and obtain it before finishing creation.

magicReferences.text: Use Toughness for Language (Magick). Casting requires suitable meat within living costs; without it, lose Wounds equal to the spell’s CN. Ordinary meat does not protect against Miscasts. Esoteric ingredients cost 1 shilling per CN or may be acquired. The page separately charges CN Wounds when casting without a suitable ingredient; the GM must adjudicate this wording. These references do not automatically deduct Wounds or coins.

After successfully casting a Great Maw Lore spell, roll 1d10. On 10 or a result equal to or above the unmodified CN, recover that many Wounds. Use the unmodified CN despite Channelling or a Grimoire. Ingredients include bloody animal parts, unusual bile, marrow and cured fat. Healing is a play reference and is not applied automatically.

Retain five printed Species Talents, using Resistant as the core heading; omit old Large Talent and record Large size separately. Native Reikspiel is explicit; Grumbarth remains selectable. Carrying capacity is doubled after core Talent effects. Use current core Size rules, not the old combat summary on p. 28.

talents.name: Vice (Target)
talents.text: Max: Willpower Bonus. Tests: Willpower to resist the chosen Vice. Each purchase gives a different Vice, such as Alcohol, Food, Narcotics or Pleasure. Encountering its target requires a Psychology Test (WFRP p. 190). Failure forces unhealthy indulgence instead of all other actions or duties, until insensible; gain one Fatigued Condition. At each later Round’s end, another Psychology Test can end this state. Fellowship Tests towards witnesses suffer −20. Each full day without indulgence adds a cumulative −20 to Psychology Tests until you indulge.

spells.name: Bonecrusher
spells.text: A Damage +4 magic missile ignores Armour Points but allows Toughness Bonus. If it causes a Critical Wound, add +20 to the severity roll on the relevant Critical Wound table. Casting requires chewing a mouthful of bones.
spells.conversion: Current core Creature Traits apply; old page references identify Fourth Edition. Numeric effect modifiers remain printed unless explicitly converted here.

spells.name: Bullgorger
spells.text: Consume a mighty beast’s heart to grant the target +2 Strength Bonus for Damage and other appropriate feats of Strength for the duration. When it ends, the target must immediately eat a substantial meal or gain a Fatigued Condition. An unwilling target can reject the effect with a Difficult (−1 SL) Cool Test.
spells.conversion: Current core Creature Traits apply; old page references identify Fourth Edition. Numeric effect modifiers remain printed unless explicitly converted here. User resolves conflicting Difficult (+20) by the difficulty label: Difficult (−1 SL).

spells.name: Braingobbler
spells.text: After eating a whole head, including its brains, gain Fear 2 (WFRP p. 341). Anyone resisting this Fear who had a close relationship with the head’s former owner takes −20 on their Cool Tests.
spells.conversion: Current core Creature Traits apply; old page references identify Fourth Edition. Numeric effect modifiers remain printed unless explicitly converted here.

spells.name: Taste Death
spells.text: Eating part of a corpse reveals approximately when and how it died, including the general weapon or cause, but no further detail or culprit. A death free of poison or disease is considered clean; custom then calls for consuming the remaining corpse.
spells.conversion: Current core Creature Traits apply; old page references identify Fourth Edition. Numeric effect modifiers remain printed unless explicitly converted here.

spells.name: Trollguts
spells.text: Swallow a little Troll Bile or a similar substance to give the target Regeneration (WFRP p. 341). Ogres have no additional effect. Each non-Ogre who recovers Wounds this way must pass an Average (+2 SL) Endurance Test or develop mottled green or blue new flesh, especially on regrown limbs. This is not a mutation, though observers may mistake it for one.
spells.conversion: Current core Creature Traits apply; old page references identify Fourth Edition. Numeric effect modifiers remain printed unless explicitly converted here. Regenerate uses current core Regeneration (p. 360); Average (+20) difficulty uses +2 SL under Appendix I p. 364.
spells.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

spells.name: The Maw
spells.text: Consume most of a large beast to open a bottomless, toothed pit. Everyone in the area immediately Tests Challenging (+0 SL) Dodge. Success avoids falling but causes a Damage +8 hit, reduced by 1 per SL on that Test. Failure causes a Damage +10 hit to a random location and 3 Entangled Conditions, opposed by Strength 60; all 3 must be removed to escape. Each creature inside takes another Damage +10 hit to a random location at the end of each of its turns. When the spell ends, the pit disappears; anyone still inside suffers a Critical Wound to a random hit location.
spells.conversion: Current core Creature Traits apply; old page references identify Fourth Edition. Numeric effect modifiers remain printed unless explicitly converted here. Challenging (+0) difficulty uses +0 SL under Appendix I p. 364.
spells.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

spells.name: Feast of the Fallen
spells.text: Bathe a blade in a freshly slain foe’s blood. Chosen creatures in the area gain Vampiric (WFRP p. 343) for the duration, activating it by wounding enemies in melee without needing to bite; other healing still works. An unwilling creature can resist with a Difficult (−1 SL) Endurance Test. When the spell ends, non-Ogres who wounded an enemy in melee must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Cool or gain a Stunned Condition. If they wounded a creature with Infected or Diseased, Tests against those Traits’ harmful effects take −30.
spells.conversion: Current core Creature Traits apply; old page references identify Fourth Edition. Numeric effect modifiers remain printed unless explicitly converted here. astrology.name: Wymund the Anchorite
astrology.text: Patient scrutiny and loyalty mark this sign; forgiveness can become costly, and a final rejection implacable.

astrology.name: The Big Cross
astrology.text: This sign favours certainty and sensible choices, with a risk of passivity unless given a cause to pursue.

astrology.name: The Limner’s Line
astrology.appearance: An archer with a drawn bow
astrology.text: A creative sign associated with artistry in any profession and a tendency towards excessive self-criticism.

astrology.name: Gnuthus the Ox
astrology.text: Loyalty, honesty and keeping promises define this sign; misplaced trust or allegiance may prove costly.

astrology.name: Dragomas the Drake
astrology.text: Confidence and natural leadership characterise this sign, with a risk of arrogance and tyranny.

astrology.name: The Gloaming
astrology.appearance: A collection of red and blue stars that appears only at twilight
astrology.text: Scepticism can produce able investigators and scholars, but also suspicion and distrust of anything beyond physical proof, even among those drawn to magic.

astrology.name: Grungni’s Baldric
astrology.text: This sign favours honour, discipline and a soldier’s rigour; relaxation and humour may come less easily.

astrology.name: Mammit the Wise
astrology.text: Curiosity and reflection encourage fairness and learning, but detached study of others’ suffering can become cruelty.

astrology.name: Mummit the Fool
astrology.text: Intuition, good sense and apparent luck accompany a tendency towards impulsiveness, wandering and avoiding responsibility.

astrology.name: The Two Bullocks
astrology.text: Diligent inventors seek useful improvements for others, though impractical projects and manipulated idealism can lead them astray.

astrology.name: The Dancer
astrology.text: Passionate commitment can become obsession, and rejection may provoke violence. Impassioned Zeal’s focus can be selected later in play (p. 43).

astrology.name: The Drummer
astrology.text: Generosity and enthusiasm for company mark this sign, but unchecked indulgence can become ruinous.

astrology.name: The Piper
astrology.text: Tact and cunning favour diplomacy and theft; self-interest may override loyalty. The associated deity is disputed, and Marienburg considers the sign fortunate.

astrology.name: Vobist the Faint
astrology.text: An apparently uncertain temperament can alternate between caution and surprising courage, reflecting an instinct for choosing battles. A full Morrslieb during its ascendance is an ill omen.

astrology.name: The Broken Cart
astrology.appearance: A cart with a broken wheel
astrology.text: Concern for status and possessions can become confidence once insecurity fades. The sign’s widely recognised link to disease conceals a rarely admitted association with Nurgle; desperation can draw people towards forbidden offerings.

astrology.name: The Greased Goat
astrology.text: Fear of disappointment can create distance and self-pity, though rare happiness spreads to others. Magically gifted children of this sign often favour Ghur.

astrology.name: Rhya’s Cauldron
astrology.text: Associated with life’s growth and death, this sign favours mercy and justice; relentless pursuit of ideals can disregard others’ welfare. Astromancers, astrologers, and Jade and Amethyst Wizards revere it.

astrology.name: Cackelfax the Cockerel
astrology.text: Ambition and practical acquisition of wealth, skills, influence and connections define this sign. Loyalty to supporters may accompany greed or ruthlessness.

astrology.name: The Bonesaw
astrology.text: An enquiring sign that seeks experiments, exploration and widespread sharing of knowledge, sometimes appearing overbearing.

astrology.name: The Witchling Star
astrology.text: This ominous magical sign suggests courage, adaptability and charm, together with a changeable nature that can trouble companions.

notes: Fifth Edition core creation allocations, Career trackers and Talent/Creature Trait definitions govern; descriptive play effects remain references.
User-approved Hedgecraft duplicate handling: retain the six core definitions and import nine new spell names. Fellstave has seven printed target specialisations.
Altdorf profiles retain core physical Species/native Languages and five Skills at +5. Eastender Criminal-or-random is one exclusive Talent slot.
User-approved optional Cants: select free abilities after one, three and six spells of a Colour Lore; live Channelling and power tracking are deferred.
Old Faith: six chosen Blessings from Bless, one additional from Invoke; paid extras use core Miracle prices counting only Invoke and purchased Blessings, as approved by the user.
User skips the alternative armour chapter entirely; core armour remains unchanged.

User defers familiars to the character-manager phase. Businesses and ongoing armour repair/looting remain deferred; GM creation enables reviewed prayer/Hedgecraft options without named NPCs, familiars or alternative armour.

Global search also includes reviewed printed gameplay references independently of creator support. These preserve source mechanics and old core-page references; Fourth Edition source warnings do not imply an adaptation or creator handler.

spells.name: A Deal’s a Deal
spells.text: After a successful Haggle Test, thank Handrich and shake hands to add +2 SL to that Test, increased by 1 per +2 SL on the Pray Test invoking this Miracle. The other negotiator also forms a favourable impression of you.
spells.conversion: Use Fifth Edition magic and core Traits/Talents. Valid old Test Difficulties use Appendix I SL modifiers; ordinary printed numeric bonuses remain reference text. Play effects are not automated.

spells.name: Carry My Burdens
spells.target: One non-monstrous creature (as determined by the GM)
spells.text: Once delivery of goods has been agreed, pass an Animal Training Test to make the target serve as your pack animal, regardless of its usual aggression or wildness. It carries whatever you require during the journey but neither attacks nor obeys other commands. It returns to its wild state on arrival. Only one creature can be affected at once.

spells.name: Shake On It
spells.text: Seal a deal with a handshake. The target cannot oppose its terms for at least Fellowship Bonus Rounds. To contest them, they must beat your SL on an Average (+2 SL) Cool Test; success permits refusing one required action, and each additional 2 SL permits one action against the deal. You sense any breach. Breaking it yourself while the Miracle lasts gives you +1 Sin point.
spells.conversion: Use Fifth Edition magic and core Traits/Talents. Valid old Test Difficulties use Appendix I SL modifiers; ordinary printed numeric bonuses remain reference text. Play effects are not automated.
spells.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty modifiers converted to Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I).

spells.name: Supply and Demand
spells.target: One batch of trade goods in line of sight
spells.text: First locate a buyer or seller of particular goods with Difficult (−1 SL) Gossip. Then alter those goods’ Availability by one level to change their Bartering Ratio (WFRP p. 291). Their apparent supply increases or decreases; goods you possess are unaffected.
spells.conversion: Use Fifth Edition magic and core Traits/Talents. Valid old Test Difficulties use Appendix I SL modifiers; ordinary printed numeric bonuses remain reference text. Play effects are not automated.

spells.text: Give a gold coin and promise future wealth while addressing people below your Status. A successful Charm Test gains +1 SL per SL on the Pray Test invoking the Miracle.
spells.conversion: Use Fifth Edition magic and core Traits/Talents. Valid old Test Difficulties use Appendix I SL modifiers; ordinary printed numeric bonuses remain reference text. Play effects are not automated.

spells.name: Twist of Fortune
spells.text: You may spend 1 of the target’s Fortune points as your own. They can contest your SL with a Challenging (+0 SL) Fellowship Test: beating you preserves their point; beating you by +4 SL also lets them spend 1 of yours as their own. A transferred point must be spent before that session ends; it returns to its original owner at the next session’s start.
spells.conversion: Use Fifth Edition magic and core Traits/Talents. Valid old Test Difficulties use Appendix I SL modifiers; ordinary printed numeric bonuses remain reference text. Play effects are not automated.

spells.name: Fellstave
spells.text: When learning this spell, choose Beastmen (including Minotaurs and Centigors, excluding Skaven), Daemons, Orcs and Goblins, Ogres, Fimir, Trolls, or Undead; the GM may allow other types. Each further purchase costs the normal new-spell XP and selects another type. Whittle a wooden post at least three feet long and four inches across, carve warding symbols, and drive it into the ground before casting. For one month, matching creatures within 100 yards must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Cool or gain a Broken Condition. After recovering, they Test Challenging (+0 SL) Intuition; success identifies the Fellstave as the source of their magical panic.
spells.conversion: Use Fifth Edition magic and core Traits/Talents. Valid old Test Difficulties use Appendix I SL modifiers; ordinary printed numeric bonuses remain reference text. Play effects are not automated. Each printed target is a distinct learnable spell specialisation at normal new-spell XP. Beastmen includes Minotaurs/Centigors but excludes Skaven. No additional GM-created targets are invented.

manifest.title: Winds of Magic

notes: Fifth Edition core rules govern; revised Fourth Edition casting, Talent ranks, promotion and the extra Channelling prerequisite for multiple Elf Lores do not replace core rules.
Retain core definitions for 63 exact-name duplicate spells. Fat of the Land (p. 87) has the same effect as core Fare of the Land (p. 250) and does not add a second learnable spell.
Psychometry sacrifice unlocks paid advancement only, with no extra free Skill points, as approved by the user. Starting Scryers retain ordinary Fifth Edition allocations.

Ritual memorisation uses the printed Learning XP; performance, crafting, familiar creation/progression, NPCs, environmental magic, potions and adventures remain campaign material. No ingredient/manufacturing/sales values become invented retail prices.

User approves Lore (Alchemy) as a selectable specialisation with Savant requiring an Advance, and caps Mundane Alchemist free Petty spells at min(WP Bonus at acquisition, 4) without extra XP or banked spells.
User defers Enchanted Staff commissioning; keep only an acquired-Trapping reference, not an ordinary shop purchase.
User approves the three printed second-hand illicit-market robe prices with their qualification. Lore-dependent equipment modifiers remain descriptions; promotion does not automatically grant gifts.

Global search also includes reviewed printed gameplay references independently of creator support. These preserve source mechanics and old core-page references; Fourth Edition source warnings do not imply an adaptation or creator handler.

skills.text: An innate Human gift: perceive recent events or unspoken thoughts at a connected location or while touching an associated person/object. Each use requires Average (+2 SL) Endurance or gives 1 Fatigued. Incompatible with Augury (p. 48).

Targets on or beside it need Challenging (+0 SL) Dodge to avoid falling; Marginal Failure allows grabbing the edge. Horses and vehicles fall automatically, and structures may partly collapse. At expiry it closes, dealing 20 Damage to trapped victims and burying them alive with Suffocation (WFRP p. 181).

spells.name: Erect the Edifice
spells.text: Raise a wall from local earth and stone, 5 yards long, 1 yard high and 6 inches thick, providing Hard Cover (WFRP p. 161), or Earthwork under Up In Arms artillery rules. Each +2 SL allows an extra round adding 5 yards length or 1 yard height; each extra yard of height adds 6 inches thickness. Each 2-yard section may have one door/window opening. A bend or curve costs +2 SL. Repeated castings can make a building shell, but it collapses after Willpower Bonus + SL days unless you or an adviser present during casting have Lore (Engineering) or Trade (Stoneworker). The spell makes no basements, floors or roofs; finishing needs carpentry.

references.text: Adaptation warning: user-approved proposed adaptation: start Gnomes at Fate 2 and Fortune 2, with no discretionary points. The source instead gives Fate 2, Resilience 0 and two extra points, without Fifth Edition values. Apply normal Fifth Edition random-creation bonuses.

One Language (Magick) Advance lets a Gnome attempt Dispelling without a casting Talent. Gnome wizards may learn Shadows, Dark Magic and Chaos Magic; their society outlaws Necromancy, Daemonology and every Chaos Magic Lore. The creator supports only Shadows through normal Arcane Lore selection; dark/Chaos training and live Dispelling are deferred.

Inherit clan from the mother; marriage does not change it, though an epithet may conceal it. Eyes grey with age, usually completely by 200, while hair eventually turns deep silver. Use the source’s 2d10 appearance tables without added age thresholds or reroll rules.

runes.conversion: Learned rune knowledge only, not an owned enchanted item. Printed numeric modifiers remain in reference text; Advantage references use Momentum. Core Creature Traits/Talents apply. Rune forging and live activation are deferred.

manifest.title: High Elf Player’s Guide

notes: Printed pages match PDF positions. Fifth Edition core rules govern creation and XP unless the user explicitly approved a guide-specific adaptation.

Eleven regional profiles retain printed Talent slots and core High Elf physical benefits, with five distinct Species Skills at +5. Ungrouped Animal Care/Sail use core totals and retain printed context.
Career table overlaps are corrected by user approval: Outer Guard 89–90, Avelorn Scholar 13–17. Core Career aliases are documented in each table.
Mage levels 1–4 and all learnable spell profiles are included. Archmage level five and the three advanced Elf priest career branches are deferred until the manager phase by user choice.
Mage uses 10 individual Channelling points and four qualifying spells before the next Colour Lore; other Elf Careers retain the core prerequisite.
Martial Arts and Lileath’s Blessing retain their printed Bonus-based caps; High Magic is permitted once with an explicit adaptation warning. No free High Magic spell is invented.
Core equipment profiles/prices are preserved. New equipment uses printed qualified Elf-market prices; Unique items are acquired-Trapping references. Ithiltaen Helm AP remains unresolved.

Elder creation uses printed individual Skill points alongside normal allocations, with separate per-era caps and no tracker boxes/free Talent/gear. The lost old extra point becomes a user-approved choice of −1 starting Fate or Fortune.
Blood of Aenarion uses the approved noble definition, core mental-corruption effects as Psychology and discounts only legal purchases. Ritual discount: included by user decision.
Yenlui, Dreams, Obsessions, naval combat, live casting, sacrifices, crafting and intrigues remain reference/background or future manager systems.

Global search also includes reviewed printed gameplay references independently of creator support. These preserve source mechanics and old core-page references; Fourth Edition source warnings do not imply an adaptation or creator handler.

rows.text: Create a major artistic or scholarly work whose reputation will endure for centuries.
Defeat the Dark Elves permanently by persuading Ulthuan to strengthen its armies.
Make a chosen kingdom Ulthuan's leading realm, whether rebuilding a ruined land such as Yvresse or sustaining an established power such as Eataine.
Restore High Elf overseas dominions and persuade Ulthuan to expand its fleets.
Prevent Ulthuan from spending its lives and wealth on alliances with Humans or Dwarfs.
Explore distant, remote lands and witness sights no Elf has seen before.
Find deep mutual understanding through enduring friendship or love.
Teach a philosophy that improves future lives: moral reform, ending suffering or encouraging pleasure.
Acquire the wealth and influence needed to keep family, friends or neighbours safe and comfortable.
Achieve emotional self-mastery and inner peace.
Ulthuan burns in war while a king and general unite and a Dragon rises: Morvael and Mentheus's story. It may urge suitable delegation, warn that a friend is endangered or foretell personal disaster.
Two armoured powers battle in the heavens; one falls and the victor exults, recalling Khaine's defeat of Vaul. It may warn of failed revenge or a trap.
As Oeric's lifelong apprentice, you watch him sculpt an Elf maiden in white marble. Possible meanings include perilous temptation, recovering a loss or beginning a masterwork.
Anlec's storm-battered towers glow with green witchfire as harpies circle above ice-cold waves. It may reveal a dangerous building or enemies secretly preparing an assault.
You tumble through the Great Vortex while mages remain calm within the Winds. It may demand a great sacrifice to prevent disaster or signal a major, hazardous undertaking.
The well-travelled Malerion befriends High King Snorri Whitebeard before seeking the Phoenix Throne. This may predict either a valuable new friendship or betrayal by someone close.

Khaine rages after his treasures are stolen and hidden in the mortal world, beyond the gods' reach. It may warn of losing a precious possession, suggest recovering a stolen/lost item, reveal changed loyalties or caution against a lover's manipulation.

An admiral orders a dragonship to ram a floating fortress amid dark seas and drifting ice. Bold action may win a great victory, but consolidating recent gains may be necessary before risking overextension.
Flamespyre Phoenixes rise from white stone pillars, calling through flaming wings. It may promise reinvention, renewed purpose or escape from death.
An ancient Dragon briefly wakes, finds the world too cold and returns to sleep. It may condemn ignoring a growing threat for comfort, or indicate that conditions are wrong for a desired action.

manifest.title: Blood and Bramble

notes: Adds twelve Hedgecraft and twelve Witchcraft spell profiles from detailed entries pp. 6–17. Existing Fifth Edition Lore Talents, free spell grants, learning prices and core Traits/Talents apply; no additional free spells or Careers.
Named old Test Difficulty modifiers are converted using Appendix I. Ordinary printed numeric bonuses/penalties remain descriptions. Fourth Edition core page references are identified explicitly.

Hedgecraft ingredient requirements and printed foraging/price information (p. 6) are retained as references. No free ingredients, potions, enchanted weapons, spirits or summoned creatures are granted.
User selected Godspakt’s detailed p. 10 You/You profile; its PDF p. 28 card instead prints Touch/1. The mismatch remains visible in its description.
User approved a 5-penny Hedgecraft ingredient shop entry with unknown Encumbrance, unspecified supplied amount and unlisted Availability, all explicitly noted.
Nameless Summons p. 17 prints overlapping −0/+0 results. Both are retained as references without choosing errata or automating summoning.
NPC profiles, adventure hooks, live casting, Condition/curse handling, spirit bargaining and summoning are deferred to campaign management.

Global search also includes reviewed printed gameplay references independently of creator support. These preserve source mechanics and old core-page references; Fourth Edition source warnings do not imply an adaptation or creator handler.

Enchant a dowsing instrument for a spirit you can name. Anyone can use it to find that spirit’s fetter: a nature spirit’s home, or a ghost’s remains, valued object or connected person. Following it requires an Extended Difficult (−1 SL) Navigate Test, one Test per hour, needing 5–15 SL according to distance, concealment and deliberate obstruction. Nameless Summons table (p. 17), printed results: −5 or worse: a greater daemon’s forelimb drags you into its realm; Hostile; gift: your flesh, blood and soul. −4 to −0: a Lesser Daemon or powerful spirit (Cairn Wraith or Tomb Banshee); Hostile; immediate sacrifice of 1d10 living, sentient creatures. +0 to +4: a Lesser Daemon or powerful spirit; Neutral; sacrifice of one living, sentient creature. +5 to +9: a Lesser Daemon or powerful spirit; Favourable; promise of a future sacrifice or great service. +10 or better: a Greater Daemon interested in speaking rather than killing outright; Neutral if demands are met, Hostile otherwise; future great service and your essence at death. spells.text: Chew earth-encrusted bedrock from a mountain peak, then Test Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance; failure costs one tooth per −1 SL. Successful casting gives you and friendly Ogres in the area +20 to Endurance and Cool Tests and +1 AP at every location for the duration.

spells.text: The target takes −1 SL to every Test for the duration, increased to −2 SL while wearing metal armour.

spells.text: The target must win an Opposed Strength Test against Strength 80 to escape a giant hand. Failure causes a 10 Damage body hit, then a fall from 2d10 yards.

spells.name: Night Shroud
spells.text: Throw a black-capped nightshade mushroom to create a cloud. Everyone inside gains Blinded and must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Perception when trying to move or gain Prone. Night Vision or Dark Vision makes a character immune to both effects.

spells.name: Nikkit!
spells.text: Attempt to pick a pocket in range using Sleight of Hand 55. After a successful theft, the victim may pass Challenging (+0 SL) Perception to see the conjured hands returning the loot to the Shaman.

spells.text: Affected targets’ blows gain Impale and Penetrating.

spells.name: Vindictive Glare
spells.text: A Damage +4 magic missile strikes everyone in the area. Targets taking Damage must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Cool or gain Stunned.

spells.name: ‘Ard as Nails
spells.text: The target gains Hatred of all enemies, ignores harmful effects of Conditions and Diseases, and adds +2 SL to Toughness-based Tests.

spells.text: Allocate one Momentum per Casting SL among allied Orcs, Goblins and Hobgoblins in range. Multiple points may go to one target.
spells.adaptation: Printed individual Advantage uses Momentum; the Fourth Edition Group Advantage alternative is omitted.

spells.name: Brainbursta
spells.text: The target immediately gains Prone and Stunned, plus one additional Stunned per Casting SL. If its Stunned Conditions exceed Toughness Bonus, it must immediately pass Average (+2 SL) Cool or take a Critical Hit to the head.
spells.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty converted to Fifth Edition SL (core Appendix I p. 364).

songs.name: We’re all in this together so, heave ho, heave ho…
songs.text: Crew members gain +10 to their individual Tests within a Crew Test.

songs.name: Jacques Bret came sailing to meet our steel!
songs.text: Each crew member gains +1 SL on successful Melee Tests.

songs.name: Of all the terrors upon the sea…
songs.text: Crew members gain +1 SL to Cool Tests.

songs.name: You band of shipmates gather round…
songs.text: Crew members gain +1 SL to Fellowship Tests intended to befriend or calm fellow crew.

songs.name: All arise, for the night has eyes…
songs.text: Those trying to stay awake gain +20 to Tests that could make them fall asleep and +10 to Perception Tests.

songs.name: The ladies of L’Anguille…
songs.text: Anyone singing along may ignore one Condition.

songs.name: They do say do as the Captain do say…
songs.text: The Captain or another onboard authority gains +20 to Fellowship Tests targeting the crew.

talents.text: Each purchase teaches a different p. 67 chanty. Perform an Entertain (Singing) Test where the crew can hear you. Establishing it takes 30 seconds; its effect then lasts three minutes plus SL minutes and affects the crew. Dodge is your only combat action while singing; the GM may permit other actions such as Perception or Cool Tests. Damage or any failed Opposed Test ends it. Sing one chanty each watch.
talents.adaptation: User-approved printed Intelligence Bonus limit and effects; old default per-rank Test bonuses omitted. Songs use their printed effects as references only.

talents.name: Master and Commander
talents.text: Appropriate Leadership Tests aboard your ship or involving your crew gain +1 SL per Master and Commander level. Applies to individual Leadership and Crew Tests.
talents.adaptation: User-approved printed Fellowship Bonus limit and explicit per-rank Leadership effect retained. No additional old default Test bonus; situational effect is not automated.

spells.name: Blessings of Bel Shanaar
spells.text: Cast while travelling towards a fixed destination whose location you know. For the duration, your Navigation Tests, including Crew Tests involving you, gain +2 SL.

spells.name: Niezlib’s Optimal Firing Solution
spells.text: Cannon-firing Tests gain +1 SL for the duration.

spells.name: Sea of Glass
spells.text: Ask everyone aboard to be silent, then close your eyes. Apply Doldrums from the Wind Effect Table (p. 107) for the duration.
spells.conversion: Printed WiIlpower spelling normalised to Willpower; no rule change.

spells.name: Living Mire
spells.text: Ensnare a ship at sea in seaweed, giving −2 Movement and −3 SL Manoeuvre. Its crew can cut it free with an Extended Challenging (+0 SL) Boat Handling Test requiring your Willpower Bonus + casting SL.

spells.name: Water Water Everywhere
spells.text: Purify seawater and direct it into the ship’s stores to refill empty water barrels.

spells.name: Whirlpool
spells.text: Create Gentle Rotation in the target area (whirlpools, p. 114). Normal Overcasting can enlarge it. Strength options: 5 SL — Whirlpool; 8 SL — Powerful Vortex; 13 SL — A Maelstrom; 21+ SL — The Maelstrom.

spells.name: Breathe Water
spells.text: The target breathes water and ignores Suffocation from drowning in water (WFRP p. 181) for the duration. You cannot invoke this while your own mouth is underwater.

spells.name: Quell Waters
spells.text: Reduce a strait or whirlpool’s M rating to 0 for the duration.

spells.name: Sea Curse
spells.text: Target a ship crewed by those unworthy of Manann’s respect, including Chaos followers, Stromfels worshippers, Orcs and Goblins, Skaven or a crew with negative Manann’s Mood. For the duration, every hit received by that crew gains +2 Damage.

spells.name: Repel Sea Beast
spells.target: 1 creature with the Aquatic Trait (see Death on the Reik Companion, page 90) or the Marine Creature Trait (see page 140)
spells.text: A sea creature takes no hostile actions for the duration, unless it suffers Damage or harmful Conditions.

spells.name: Rip Tides
spells.text: A visible ship takes −1 M and −1 SL Man.

spells.name: Blessed Voyage
spells.text: Invoke when calculating Manann’s Mood. Improve it by 2d10 minus your current Sin Points.

spells.name: Blessing of the Albatross
spells.text: An albatross arrives and waits up to 1 hour for sailing, then follows the ship for the duration. While it remains, the ship cannot sink regardless of Damage. Killing it gives the ship −d10 Morale and −2d10 Manann’s Mood. If needed, use the pigeon profile (WFRP p. 316), changed to Small Size and 3 Wounds.

spells.name: Blessing of the Mariner
spells.text: The target gains +1 SL on Row, Sail and Swim Tests.

spells.name: Raging Seas
spells.text: Strike a specific target in the sea or on shore with a wave of CR 15.

spells.name: Send ‘em to Stromfels
spells.text: Double the target ship’s Holed Rating (p. 117).

spells.name: Storm Winds
spells.text: Increase wind intensity for one ship by one step for the duration (p. 107), without changing direction.

spells.name: Blood Trail
spells.text: Track an injured person over land or water with Easy (+4 SL) Track, smelling even tiny or partially removed blood traces.
spells.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty uses Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I p. 364).

spells.name: Curse of the Harsh Mistress
spells.text: The target suffers nightmares. Whenever resting to remove Fatigued Conditions, they must pass Difficult (−1 SL) Cool or retain the Fatigued Condition.
spells.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty uses Fifth Edition SL modifiers (core Appendix I p. 364).

spells.name: Manann’s Mood Made Meaningless
spells.text: For your current ship, roll on the Manann’s Mood table below, adding 1 per Sin Point. 1 to 4: Stromfels Triumphant! Treat Mood as 0 for the duration. 5 to 8: Stromfels Ascends! Roll 5d10, adding it to negative Mood or subtracting it from positive Mood. 9: No effect; calculate Mood normally. 10 or more: Manann Provoked! Subtract 5d10 from Mood (p. 130).

spells.text: Create non-magical fog that limits visibility to 10 yards and cannot be Dispelled.

spells.name: Uproot the Mountains
spells.text: Shake a hill or mountain. At the start of each target’s Round, Very Hard (−3 SL) Athletics is required to avoid Prone and losing all actions and movement. Overcasting: each extra Round of Duration lets you move the terrain Willpower Bonus yards; anyone in its path must pass Average (+2 SL) Athletics or take 10 Damage to a random location. +5 SL can trigger an avalanche, requiring Challenging (+0 SL) Dodge from anyone in its path to avoid 15 Damage to a random location.
spells.adaptation: Printed named Test Difficulties use Fifth Edition SL modifiers; existing High Magic definitions and learning rules are preserved.

spells.name: Earth Line
spells.text: Slann only; requires a geomantic nexus or leyline within Willpower Bonus miles. Send energy along a leyline in your chosen direction to the next nexus. Anyone on it must pass Hard (−2 SL) Endurance or take 15 body Damage, reduced by Toughness Bonus but ignoring Armour. Overcasting: +4 SL creates an undispellable bridge 8 yards wide along the leyline, of any length across water of any depth, lasting Willpower Bonus hours; +6 SL clears an 8-yard-wide path through forest or jungle along the line.
spells.adaptation: Printed named Test Difficulties use Fifth Edition SL modifiers; existing High Magic definitions and learning rules are preserved.

spells.name: Ruination of Cities
spells.text: Slann only; requires a geomantic nexus or leyline within Willpower Bonus miles. Collapse an unfortified building, wall or bridge into Difficult terrain. Occupants must pass Hard (−2 SL) Dodge or take 20 body Damage and become buried, suffering Suffocation (WFRP p. 181). Overcasting extra targets must select those nearest the first. Ground between them opens into a crevasse 2 yards wide and 4 yards deep; Challenging (+0 SL) Dodge avoids falling, while a Marginal Failure permits grabbing the edge. +6 SL permits fortified targets such as castle walls or towers.
spells.adaptation: Printed named Test Difficulties use Fifth Edition SL modifiers; existing High Magic definitions and learning rules are preserved.

spells.name: Mental Blast
spells.text: Slann only; requires a geomantic nexus or leyline within Willpower Bonus miles. Enemies take Intelligence Bonus + 6 Damage, plus 6 if Daemonic or Undead, allowing Toughness Bonus but ignoring Armour. Average (+2 SL) Intelligence is also required to avoid Stunned. Overcasting: +6 SL, The Deliverance of Itza, changes Target diameter to AoE (Half Willpower yards), centred on the caster and expandable normally. +9 SL, The Great Leveller, sacrifices the Slann to kill enough outnumbering enemies in line of sight to equal the Slann’s allies in number, taking lowest Intelligence first. Only spending a Fate Point prevents a Character’s resulting instant death.
spells.adaptation: Printed named Test Difficulties use Fifth Edition SL modifiers; existing High Magic definitions and learning rules are preserved.

spells.name: Waterlungs (Mathlann)
spells.text: Only Elven Priests of Mathlann may use this Miracle. Targets breathe underwater but suffer Suffocation and Drowning in air (WFRP p. 181), feel drawn to water, and need only a bucketful to breathe. Each +2 SL adds one target.

spells.name: Cloak of Mathlann (Mathlann)
spells.text: Only Elven Priests of Mathlann may use this Miracle. A ship and crew become invisible, though those aboard still see its interior. Crew leaving become visible. Challenging (+0) Perception can notice the wake or fog eddies. Beyond one mast, each extra mast requires +2 SL. Black Arks and sea monsters are excluded.
